title: Area-code-hunt shard B pass — NPAs 448, 463, 469

data.research_question: Which public organizations and publicly documented organizational actors are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 448, 463 and 469?
data.method: NANPA admission before deterministic NPA mod 3 sharding; literal anarchist/ABC/FNB/mutual-aid searches plus locality searches; current-status verification; first-party and organization-controlled pages; public social/link hubs; repository dedupe; public-person enumeration limited to explicit organizational roles without belief inference.
classification_rules: Do not infer an individual's political beliefs from organizational role or proximity.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level evidence.
Overlay geography is a locality-discovery relation unless the organization itself publishes the overlay NPA.
Historical directories are discovery seeds only until current status is corroborated.
Do not merge identities from name or handle similarity alone.
Completed NPAs are not repeated without materially new evidence.

findings.notes: Tallahassee FNB current first-party; Pensacola FNB recent through Dec 2025 with 2026 status unresolved.
Circle City Mutual Aid and HamCo FNB are current; existing canonical Food Not Bombs Indianapolis reused from the 317 overlay geography.
DFW Support Committee has direct 469 public contact attribution; Feed The People DTX has current public organization Linktree.

unresolved: Resolve a fresh 2026 first-party activity signal for Food Not Bombs Pensacola before upgrading it from recent to current.
Resolve Circle City Mutual Aid's organization-owned social profiles; current first-party page exposes email but social-link destinations were not recoverable in this pass.
Follow Tallahassee FNB's explicitly named collaborator edges only where those organizations remain current and in-scope.
Resolve whether HamCo Food Not Bombs has current organization-controlled Instagram/X endpoints beyond its Facebook, Bluesky and Linktree.
Do not join Matt Armstrong to any personal social account without a source-linked identifier; the name is collision-prone.
Resolve additional current public representatives for Tallahassee FNB, Pensacola FNB and Circle City Mutual Aid only from explicit public sources.
Resolve Feed The People DTX's exact current X handle from the organization Linktree before storing a guessed username.
DFW Support Committee sources also expose single-name public representatives such as Albert/Lee; leave them unresolved rather than creating ambiguous person identities.

summary: Bounded shard-B area-code organization and public-role enumeration pass.

gaps: Several organization/public-person social endpoints remain unresolved rather than guessed.
